name: Feasibility: Invoicing
description:
Part of the business dashboard. Covers both affiliate commissions and add-on revenue.

h2. Scope in PRD

- Central place where a partner finds an overview of invoices — both issued by them and issued to them
- Partner can submit commission calculation inputs directly in the portal
- Each add-on retains its unique form link; the portal is the centralised entry point for accessing and submitting these forms
- Submitted data feeds the existing invoicing process in Salesforce
- Reduces dependency on email for routine monthly invoicing submissions

h2. To analyse

- Where invoices live today and whether they can be read per partner (Salesforce, accounting system)
- Whether the portal only links out to existing forms or actually replaces them
- Write path into the existing Salesforce invoicing process
- Legal/accounting constraints on displaying and storing invoice documents
- Dependency on Affiliate program and Addons — business commission data

h2. Output

Systems involved, integration gaps, T-shirt size, blockers, MVP / later / out-of-scope recommendation.
